messages.subject: Access label of actionLink with shinytest
parts:
Trying to get something done with the shinytest package...

I have an actionLink

actionLink("userid", "nothing")

which can be updated in some reactive context:

updateActionButton(session, "userid", url )

I can retrieve the click-count with app$getValue("userid"), but I did not find a way to access the text of the button.

Any idea?
